fusions.name: Glancing Nip
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. You spring away 15% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Frozen at the Rustle
fusions.desc: A sudden strike that deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns each of them for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Flight Response
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 6 seconds and springs you 2 tiles from where you stood, with 10% more dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Stepped On
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
